nordic.text: Digital and AI work is delivered together with Nordic AI, our main technology partner: proven platforms you can deploy as-is or customise, and fixed-scope phases from first prototype to production.

packages.title: Concept Sprint
packages.tagline: Turn an idea into a working prototype.

packages.title: MVP Accelerator
packages.tagline: Build a product people can actually use.

packages.title: Product Launch & Scale
packages.tagline: Take your product from MVP to production.
packages.bestFor: Strategic digital products and enterprise initiatives.

solutions.title: Marketing Management Platform
solutions.description: An integrated platform for managing marketing campaigns, partnerships, commercial relationships, digital assets, and performance analytics in one centralised environment.

solutions.title: E-commerce Platform
solutions.description: A flexible digital commerce solution for managing product catalogues, online storefronts, customer journeys, and transactions across multiple sales channels.

solutions.title: Media & Streaming Platform
solutions.description: A unified digital environment for publishing, managing, and distributing live streams, video content, events, and editorial materials across digital channels.

solutions.title: Performance Management Platform
solutions.description: An integrated solution for managing individual and team performance, planning activities, tracking progress, and analysing results through centralised dashboards and reporting tools.

solutions.title: Operations & Booking Platform
solutions.description: A configurable platform for managing bookings, resources, pricing, customer interactions, and operational workflows through a unified management system.

solutions.title: Website & Workflow Automation Platform
solutions.description: A flexible digital platform combining website management, content publishing, and AI-powered workflow automation to simplify business operations and reduce repetitive manual tasks.

solutions.title: 3D Configurator Engine
solutions.description: A modular 3D configuration engine for designing and pricing buildable structures in the browser, assembling validated modules into a complete specification.

solutions.title: Events & Service Marketplace
solutions.description: A marketplace for discovering and booking events, classes and services, with provider listings, availability search, and multi-audience browsing in one place.

solutions.title: AI Back-Office Platform
solutions.description: An AI-driven back-office system that intakes case documents, extracts and structures their contents, and moves each case through its workflow with less manual handling.

solutions.title: Inspection Management Platform
solutions.description: Field inspection software for buildings and assets — capture defects with photos and voice notes, generate consistent reports with AI assistance, and track every issue to resolution.
